_comment: Instant - Destroy this: Prevent the next 1 arcane damage that would be dealt to you this turn; if you've boosted this turn, INSTEAD prevent the next 2. Modeled as an ACTIVATE with a destroy-this cost and a CONDITIONAL_EFFECT on the BOOSTED flag (then PREVENT_DAMAGE 2, else 1). Prior JSON gated the whole ability on BOOSTED (no prevention at all when not boosted), used an unrecognized 'additional_effects' key, and only SET_FLAG (which nothing consumed). Flag-name fix: this ability read a flag NOTHING ever set, so it could never fire. The engine records fusion as "fused_<slug>" (ability_keywords.fusion), boost as "boosted_this_turn", and a played Lightning card as "played_lightning" — all lowercase. Was: BOOSTED_THIS_TURN.
